newsitem.title: UK: Tate & Lyle dips ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Tate & Lyle dips ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in sugar producer Tate & Lyle Plc dipped in a rising UK equity market on Tuesday after a weekend press report said the stock was likely to come under further pressure ahead of results on Wednesday, dealers said.
Tate shares were down 2-1/2p at 447-1/2 by 0933 GMT in thin trade of 119,702 shares, even as the FTSE 100 index was up 23.7 points at 4,479.3.
A report in the Sunday Times said the company was likely to post a sharp fall in first-half pre-tax profits to less than 120 million stg from 168 million a year before.
Analysts last week said they expected Tate's results to be hit by a poor performance from Tate's A.E. Staley unit in the U.S., which makes high fructose syrup used by soft drinks producers.
